newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices strong with hot temperatures.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices strong with hot temperatures.

text.p: Spot electricity prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) maintained strength Monday with significant air conditioning demand due to heat in much of the state, industry sources said.
"Temperatures were in the high 90's (degrees Fahrenheit) again today," one Texas power broker said.
Next-day ERCOT power for a 16-hour on-peak block was discussed in the $20.00-21.00 range, sources said.
On-peak power for the month of October was talked in the $18.00-18.50 per megawatt hour range, the sources said.
Temperatures through Texas were forecast to be normal to above-normal from September 19-23.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
